'''Peter Roughley Griffiths''' (January 1942 – 29 August 2026) was a British chemist.

== Early life and career ==
Griffiths was born in [[London]] in January 1942. At the age of five, he and his family moved to [[Burpham]], and he attended The Royal Grammar School of King Edward VI. He also attended [[St John's College, Oxford]], earning his [[bachelor's degree]] and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]]. After earning his degrees, he emigrated to the [[United States]], and worked in [[Ellis R. Lippincott]]'s lab at the [[University of Maryland, College Park]]. He also worked at Digilab, Inc. in [[Cambridge, Massachusetts]], and at Sadtler Research Labs in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.lindquistmortuary.com/obituaries/peter-griffiths?ttm_pid=212168554|title=Peter Roughley Griffiths|work=Lindquist Mortuary|access-date=September 5, 2026}}</ref>

He served as a professor in the department of [[chemistry]] at [[Ohio University]] from 1972 to 1982.<ref name="a" /> During his years as a professor, in 1980, he was named a [[distinguished professor]].<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ohio.edu/distinguished-professor/award-recipients|title=Distinguished Professors (1959 to Current)|work=[[Ohio University]]|access-date=September 5, 2026}}</ref> In 1982, he moved to [[Riverside, California]], and taught at the [[University of California, Riverside]] for seven years.<ref name="a" />

In 2018, Griffiths was awarded an honorary [[doctor of science]] degree from the [[University of Idaho]].<ref name="a" />

== Personal life and death ==
In 1971, Griffiths married Marie Burns at the Merion Tribute House in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]].<ref name="a" /> Their marriage lasted until her death in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pressenterprise.com/obituaries/marie-griffiths-riverside-ca/|title=Marie Griffiths|work=[[The Press-Enterprise]]|date=March 22, 2016|access-date=September 5, 2026}}</ref>

Griffiths died on 29 August 2026, at the age of 84.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/name/peter-griffiths-obituary?id=62343405|title=Peter Roughley Griffiths|work=Legacy|access-date=September 5, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>
